newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Umbono invests in EcoBlend.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Umbono invests in EcoBlend.

text.p: South Africa's Umbono Investment Corp Ltd said on Friday that it had sealed a deal to invest 5.01 million rand in EcoBlend by subscribing for 20.4 percent of the firm's shares for 0.65 million rand and a variable rate venture loan of 4.37 million rand.
EcoBlend makes EcoTec which is a new chemical compound that binds soil together to form a low cost building product for use in roads, mine dump containment and dam reinforcement.
Umbono said the International Finance Corp had also agreed to invest 5.01 million rand in EcoTec and black empowerment group Geomat Investment Holdings would buy an 11.7 percent stake in the firm.
The balance of the firm's sharees are held by EcoCorp -- a firm headed by EcoTec inventor John Moody.
Umbono also said that it was still in talks which, if successful, may have an effect on its share price. Shareholders were advised to exercise caution in their sharedealings.
